definitions.explanation: The act of carrying or moving something from one place to another.
The quality of being easy to carry or transport.

notes:
{持|も}ち{運|はこ}び is a noun formed from the compound verb {持|も}ち{運|はこ}ぶ (to carry around). It is used to talk about portability or the act of transporting items.

FORMS:
⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to hold) + ⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧ (to carry). The noun form drops the final ぶ.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {持|も}ち{運|はこ}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧: convenient for carrying
- {持|も}ち{運|はこ}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧: easy to carry
- {持|も}ち{運|はこ}び⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: portable, can be carried
- {持|も}ち{運|はこ}び⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for carrying, portable-use

Used frequently in product descriptions and reviews to discuss size, weight, and portability.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ポータブル→ポータブル：noentry⟧: portable (loanword, used as modifier)
- ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧: portable, carrying (also refers to mobile phones)
- ⟦{運搬|うんぱん}→運搬：09231_unpan⟧: transport, conveyance (more formal, larger scale)
